original_logit_diagnostics.note: Descriptive original-logit distribution only; fixed oracle amplitude +/-4 was preregistered, no amplitude tuning.

bootstrap.method: Image paired sum/count. Exploratory; does not cover spatial, selection or seed uncertainty.

interpretation_limits: GT logits +/-4 are a frozen conditional diagnostic, not a mathematical upper bound. Joint point+dense replacement does not isolate either modality. Finite logits, point mining, frozen PE, distribution shift, GT boxes, existing alpha and support may limit response. No AP, UAV-attainable gain or detach-training benefit claim.
